verdict.rationale: TaxJar documents a full public REST API with API-key auth, versioned headers, and official client libraries in seven languages, covering rate lookups, transaction upload, and tax code parameters — clearly a documented public API for programmatic/agentic use. missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec or llms.txt (probes returned 404s), and no independent/hands-on corroboration of API usability beyond vendor docs.
